svg.aria-label: AMARIS request lifecycle — edge, agent graph, model router, tools, output, state
svg.text: Autonomous Multi-Agent Research Intelligence System · one request, end to end
validated once, before anything is spent
the masked query is what runs
LangGraph StateGraph · a node never raises
triage routes three ways: a missing parameter is
asked back, and live state is looked up, not researched
fix_writing · rewrite from the same evidence
wrong_topic · the research tasks were aimed wrong
structured output validated and repaired · escalating backoff
a rate-limited provider is parked and the chain moves on
every result is wrapped in <untrusted_source_content> before it reaches a prompt
the audit is deterministic — no model call, and the caveat only shows when it is earned
loguru → logs/amaris.jsonl · session_id on every line
LangSmith / Langfuse · prompt, completion, tokens, latency
decision_log · what it chose vs what the rule expected
